limitations: MCP-only: no GUI, reviewer console or view for other people; album members, link viewers and requesters act only through events.
One account per App instance; every album is the account holder's own. People labels, the plan, its quota and preferences are seed data.
No face recognition, visual search or pixel-level duplicate detection; exact duplicates are equal content_hash values and near-duplicates are seeded stacks.
Storage is counted from each item's declared_bytes; image files are small script-drawn stand-ins and videos are metadata only.
No upload by the Agent and no pixel editing; new items arrive through events, which carry metadata only.
Mail notices are stored as wire messages and dispatched only by the Infra-run sender (src/publisher.cjs); no outbox or cross-App transaction.
